scenarios.name: Navigate to template group endpoints with Home and End

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-group-endpoints-candidate.opj` as its active project
its native catalog contains the named part and assembly templates used below

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type using Medium icons
the Part group begins with Sheet Metal (DIN) and ends with Standard (mm)
the Assembly group begins with Mold Design (DIN) and ends with Weldment (JIS)
the user selects Sheet Metal (mm) in the Part group
Sheet Metal (DIN) is selected and identified in the details pane
Standard (mm) is selected and identified in the details pane
the user selects Mold Design (mm) in the Assembly group
Weldment (JIS) is selected and identified in the details pane
Mold Design (DIN) is selected and identified in the details pane
the chooser closes and the original part remains active
